lore_conversations.policy: Each record preserves a short source excerpt for reading and supplies a separate conservative performance adaptation. The tones express only matched canonical meanings; unsupported story detail remains visible in English or as a nonsemantic phonemic label.

presets.title: Remember the carriers
presets.explanation: After the feast, Brindle replaces self-credit with a shared work notice and finally carries something for Tavi. The moment turns hospitality into reciprocal care.
source_excerpt: Brindle: Meals for one another. Please include the people who carry them.
Tavi enters carrying nothing while Brindle holds the door.
presets.performance_note: The performance preserves beginning, active care, people, present location, and acting together. Era Zero does not claim a dedicated atomic meaning for meals or carrying here.

performance_turns.speaker: Tavi
performance_turns.english: Please help the people who carry the meals.

presets.title: Use the present bank
presets.source_section: High water: experiment / Falling water: the tool
presets.explanation: Pell asks Suth to guide the rescue by the bank that exists now, not by a persuasive old reflection. Their trust becomes a practical method for surviving uncertain evidence.
source_excerpt: Pell: The present bank, Suth. I need the present bank.
Suth: Left. The root is yours. The stone isn't.
presets.performance_note: The tones preserve need, current position, route, active joint movement, and a living person. They do not encode the reflected bank, the root, or the deceptive stone as special atoms.

presets.story: Lamentations for the Rooms We Did Not Carry
presets.title: Keep the objections beside one another
presets.source_section: III. Palinode's objection / V. Serein declines an arithmetic consolation
presets.explanation: Palinode and Serein refuse to have distinct objections merged into a tidier history. Later, Serein redirects attention from proving an origin toward making a wall and a latch that work now.
source_excerpt: Palinode: I will attach your objection to mine.
Serein: Yes. I heard you. Now help me place this wall.
presets.performance_note: The performance preserves preservation, data retention, assistance, placement, and a present task. Objection and wall remain referential labels rather than newly invented roots.

presets.title: Arrival is not consent
presets.explanation: Nacre challenges a station that counts reaching its hall as a completed journey. Ilex and Varo finally reopen a live exchange so the receiving bed—and the travelers themselves—can answer.
source_excerpt: Nacre: I need the low-water gate.
Varo: You are already at your destination.
Nacre: No, I am at your station.
Ilex: We need a live receiving exchange.
presets.performance_note: The tones contrast need, destination, current position, receiving, and a continuing presence. Low-water, station procedure, consent, and the exact guests remain explicit English detail.

performance_turns.speaker: Nacre
performance_turns.english: No. My current position is your station. We need a live receiving exchange.

performance_turns.speaker: Varo
performance_turns.english: I will stay until you answer.

presets.title: Ask who is using it
presets.explanation: Dema discovers a settlement inside material marked for replacement. The rescue succeeds because both scales exchange conditions, preserve rough but useful structures, and wait for an answer before acting.
source_excerpt: Dema: The join will break during heavy rain. I was going to replace the strip below it. Your town appears to be attached to that strip.
Venn: Before replacing this part, ask who is using it. Then wait for the answer.
presets.performance_note: The tones preserve discovery, care rather than cleaning, need, route, waiting as timing structure, arrival, and present location. The town, nursery, rain, and engineering details remain English referents.

performance_turns.speaker: Issa
performance_turns.english: Wait and listen for the answer.

translation_candidates: place a population into safe dormancy
maintain an ecosystem as recoverable potential
suspend life without allowing its continuity to end
distinctions_and_exclusions: The goal is not merely storage. The goal is:
atoms.source_c_reference_melody:
Opening harmony: C4–E4–G4

### Example

```text
LIF:122
TARGET:LIF:021

STATE:2
```

```text

    target = living_community,
```

```text
MOV:000 [1]
```

Natural translation:

> “This is the established starting point.”

Compact performance:

> **Gi·nam.**

In executable use, it may establish the zero coordinate:

```text
SET_ORIGIN(current_position)
```

atoms.title: present position
atoms.core_definition: The position currently occupied by an entity, signal, process, or point of attention.
distinctions_and_exclusions: Unlike `MOV:000`, this position does not have to be the journey’s origin.
atoms.source_c_reference_melody:
Opening harmony: C4–D4–G4
Address path:     C4–C4–C4–D4
source_examples_markdown:
### Example

```text
MOV:001
ENTITY:LIF:001
STATE:1
```

Natural translation:

> “I am here.”

More literally:

> “The conscious self occupies this presently valid position.”

Compact speech:

> **Ni·nak, gi·nak.**

The two `nak` syllables are distinguished by their Life and Motion harmonies.

---

atoms.title: retained position
atoms.core_definition: A source position that is preserved in memory or data but is not presently occupied.
atoms.source_c_reference_melody:
Opening harmony: C4–D4–G4
Address path:     C4–C4–C4–B♭3
source_examples_markdown:
### Example

```text
MOV:002 [1]
```

Natural translation:

> “The previous position remains recorded.”

```text
MOV:002 [2]
```

Natural translation:

> “A former location may still be recoverable, but its validity is unresolved.”

Compact speech:

> **Gi·nan-num.**

This could function as a saved checkpoint or return coordinate.

---

atoms.title: defined destination
atoms.core_definition: A stable location identified as the endpoint or target of movement.
distinctions_and_exclusions: The destination is defined, but this root does not say whether anyone is currently moving toward it.
atoms.source_c_reference_melody:
Opening harmony: C4–D4–G4
Address path:     C4–C4–D4–D4
source_examples_markdown:
### Example

```text
MOV:010 [1]
```

Natural translation:

> “That is the destination.”

Compact speech:

> **Gi·nom.**

Executable use:

```text
destination = selected_coordinate
```

---

atoms.title: active destination
atoms.core_definition: A destination that is currently reachable, accepted, and actively guiding movement.
distinctions_and_exclusions: The distinction is:
atoms.source_c_reference_melody:
Opening harmony: C4–D4–G4
Address path:     C4–C4–D4–E4
source_examples_markdown:
### Example

```text
MOV:011
TARGET:STR:010
STATE:1
```

Natural translation:

> “The shelter is our active destination.”

With a rising question contour:

> **Gi·nok?**

Possible contextual meanings:

- “Are we going there?”
- “Is that still our destination?”
- “Is the endpoint reachable?”

---

atoms.title: pending destination
atoms.core_definition: A destination that remains defined but cannot yet be reached, confirmed, or entered.
distinctions_and_exclusions: It does not mean the place is destroyed. It means the relationship between the traveler and destination has not been completed.
atoms.source_c_reference_melody:
Opening harmony: C4–D4–G4
Address path:     C4–C4–D4–C4
source_examples_markdown:
### Example

```text
MOV:012 [2]
```

Natural translation:

> “The destination remains possible, but no valid arrival is currently available.”

Compact speech:

> **Gi·non-num.**

In programming, it may represent an unresolved future:

```text
destination_status = AWAITING_ROUTE
```

---

atoms.title: established route
atoms.core_definition: A stable sequence of positions connecting one location to another.
atoms.source_c_reference_melody:
Opening harmony: C4–D4–G4
Address path:     C4–C4–B♭3–B♭3
source_examples_markdown:
### Example

```text
MOV:020
SOURCE:MOV:000
TARGET:MOV:010
STATE:1
```

Natural translation:

> “A valid route connects the origin to the destination.”

Compact speech:

> **Gi·nim.**

This is the route itself, not the act of traveling along it.

---

atoms.title: active flow network
atoms.core_definition: A system of routes currently carrying movement, traffic, signals, or transitions.
distinctions_and_exclusions: The distinction between `gi·nim` and `gi·nik` is:
atoms.source_c_reference_melody:
Opening harmony: C4–D4–G4
Address path:     C4–C4–B♭3–C4
source_examples_markdown:
### Example

```text
MOV:021 [1]
```

Natural translation:

> “The transit network is functioning.”

Compact speech:

> **Gi·nik.**

For digital systems, this could mean:

> “Data is actively moving through the network.”

The Data family would specify what is moving; the Motion family specifies the flow structure.

---

atoms.title: dormant route system
atoms.core_definition: A route, corridor, cycle, or movement network that remains structurally possible but is not presently operating.
atoms.source_c_reference_melody:
Opening harmony: C4–D4–G4
Address path:     C4–C4–B♭3–A♭3
source_examples_markdown:
### Example

```text
MOV:022 [1]
```

Natural translation:

> “A dormant route still validly exists.”

```text
MOV:022 [2]
```

Natural translation:

> “A route may remain, but whether it can be restored is unresolved.”

Compact speech:

> **Gi·nin-num.**

---
